rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly: DESeq2 with ~ subject + condition, subject as a factor blocking term, control set explicitly as reference, Wald test on the condition coefficient, with an edgeR QL fit of the same design as a cross-check. QC precedes the model (blind VST, PCA on top 500 genes, distance heatmap, library sizes, coloured by both subject and condition with pair lines) and has a stated policy to report rather than silently drop or reorder anomalous samples. The filter (>=10 counts in >=5 samples) is minimal and justified by the smallest group size; normalization is median-of-ratios/TMM inside the model on unmodified integer counts; BH at alpha=0.05 is passed to results() with independent filtering, apeglm shrinkage for ranking, and selection by padj only. Enrichment is correctly omitted with a stated reason, and the report requirements (method, versions, sessionInfo, design, contrast, thresholds, tested and DE counts, n=5 power caveat) are all explicit.
